description: This PHP class 'PhpHash' provides an implementation of incremental hashing using PHP's built-in hash functions. It allows creating hash contexts, updating them with data chunks, finalizing to produce the hash, and resetting states. It supports various algorithms and options like base64 encoding and HMAC keys.

classes.name: PhpHash
classes.description: A class implementing incremental hashing with PHP hash functions, supporting various algorithms and options like HMAC and base64 encoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PhpHash instance with a specified hashing algorithm and options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the hash context with additional data.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hash and returns the resulting hash value, optionally encoded in base64.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the hashing context and hash value.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the hashing context resource.
